risk_note: RV2 (linking/**; attribution). linking open, first stage: who the link opens for (BR-ATTR-05 cases 1-5). Share links use the sharer's snapshot; own links open as the owner; a guest link is claimed once by the first logged-in opener with a Kysely conditional update (where user_id is null) that also fills the identity snapshot's empty user_id and attr_code, and a lost race rereads and resolves as case 2 or 3; another user's non-share link gets a new link through the same insertion point as card registration, with the original quote as the baseline (amount_unknown stays unknown) and without the original owner's agent fields; an owner opening their own share link goes to the self-buy pid (BR-ATTR-11 default); 30144 for missing or foreign-app links; 10001 when login is needed. Price recheck, link_logs, attempts and idempotency are B1-06k; authorization and platform conversion B1-06e / f. Written by hand.
